# Highlight.js 11.12.0

Unmodified upstream ES modules, vendored for local syntax highlighting.
The package registers only XML/HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, Bash
and Rust. No CDN requests are made at runtime.

- Modules: [cdn-release 11.12.0](https://github.com/highlightjs/cdn-release/tree/11.12.0/build/es)
- License: [BSD 3-Clause](https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js/blob/11.12.0/LICENSE), retained in LICENSE
